mis_merges.label: traditional media stocks
subjects: streaming's secular displacement of legacy broadcast/cable viewership
mis_merges.why: the M&A leverage story (Paramount 6.5x EBITDA, Warner's leverage path) is a distinct, catalyst-driven capital-structure story that an editor would want as its own theme rather than folded into the general cord-cutting narrative.

mis_merges.label: copper power demand infrastructure
subjects: AI data-center electricity demand and grid bottlenecks
sovereign financing of copper as a strategic resource (Korea Eximbank-Glencore facility)
mis_merges.why: the Glencore financing item belongs with the other copper-supply cards, not the grid-demand narrative, and merging it there risks an editor missing the copper-financialization angle entirely.

notes: This list is representative, not exhaustive — with 134 reader labels averaging ~4.3 cards each, fragmentation is systemic: many pairs share near-verbatim duplicate sentences (e.g. identical Hormuz oil-curve figures, identical JPM 'supercycle themes' bullets restated as 'JPM' vs 'the desk'), indicating single source notes were split repeatedly across labels, often along bank-attribution wording rather than subject.
